name: Delva Celebrían
original_name: デルヴァ・ケレブリアン
source:
The level-headed leader of the dark elf army.
She leads the dark elves in their invasion to monopolize the God Tree, the source of all magic and life in Alfhelm. And as the elves are their rivals she also tries to monopolize the protagonist as well.

[spoiler]2671 years old.[/spoiler]
